newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Even UK said sympathetic to ending EU veto misuse.
newsitem.headline: Even UK said sympathetic to ending EU veto misuse.

text.p: Dutch Foreign Minister Hans van Mierlo said on Tuesday that most countries in the European Union were now willing to give up the national veto in foreign policy matters and that even Britain was understanding about the idea.
"The will to get away from the tyranny of the veto is more or less there, even in the U.K.," van Mierlo told a European Parliament committee.

Britain's Conservative government is vehemently opposed to any further loss of the veto in EU decision making and has pledged to block any move in that direction during the bloc's ongoing treaty review.
But van Mierlo said that the misuse of the veto -- which has included cases of single countries disrupting relations with non-EU countries -- was weighing on everyone in the bloc.
"People there (Britain) are not insensitive to the idea that there are limits," van Mierlo said.
The EU is aiming to complete its treaty review by the end of the Dutch presidency, in June.
